mostWorthwhile.text: Load-testing the operating radios was most worthwhile: it turned a plausible power setup into a measured overnight plan with a margin and a check time.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the solar chargers too early was the least useful passage; the failure did not explain what preparation was missing.

surprise.text: I expected the meter to measure the radios first, but it tested the battery packs instead. The operating radio loads were measured later.

arbitrary.text: The required order felt somewhat opaque when the protected reserves could not connect to the aligned radios until the controller had established the link.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how Tin Row's network exchanges service notes with Latch's, especially after the satisfying local link test.
